error.message: TUFNWGTP (the multi-year weight) is undefined for 2020 because ATUS data collection was suspended Mar 18 - May 9, 2020 and the year was reweighted with a different method (TU20FWGT). A single estimate pooling 2020 with this scheme is not statistically valid. Estimate 2020 separately with weights='pandemic' (years may only be 2019 and/or 2020 under that scheme).
